prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Sign-In Account Flow: Move sign-in after pet selection and photo steps so users build connection before account creation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [adoption, redesign] Stage Selection Adoption Redesign: Redesign pet selection into a stage view with live choice cards and animated preview.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Choose Your New Desktop Companion", "body": "Select a pet character to bring to life on your desktop.", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select Character"}]}}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Visual Verification Screen: Add a dedicated verification screen before completion to confirm the pet is visible on desktop.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_check", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_check": {"headline": "Look at Your Desktop!", "body": "Your pet should now be walking on your desktop screen.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "button", "label": "I see my pet!", "action": "next"}]}}
3: [home, new_flow] Interactive Generation Status Stream: Rebuild waiting screen with real-time generation progress bar, tips, and animated visual cues.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "split", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "headline": "Generating Your Unique Pet", "body": "We are assembling your pet's animations and desktop interactions.", "components": [{"type": "progress", "style": "highlight"}, {"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "calm"}]}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Restore Alert: Display explicit account hint clarifying that existing pets require signing into the original account.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Please log into your original account to access your existing desktop pets."}}
5: [choose_path, layout] Path Choice Spotlight Layout: Switch path choice layout to a high-contrast spotlight view for quick path selection.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Select Your Adoption Journey", "body": "Pick a ready-to-go preset pet or create a unique custom companion."}}
6: [home, notification] Pet Generation Background Notification: Enable background notifications and alert switch on the waiting screen when creation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "You can minimize this app. We will notify you when your pet is ready!"}}
7: [adoption, wait_info] Adoption Certificate Time Estimate: Show process step counter and time estimate banner during adoption certificate generation.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"show_step_counter": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "headline": "Issuing Official Pet Certificate"}}
8: [finish, incentive] Desktop Pet Quick Controls Intro: Display visual interactive tip cards on home intro screen explaining click controls and tray options.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Ready!", "body": "Click your pet to interact, or right-click the system tray icon to hide or customize settings.", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "animation", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Start Exploring", "action": "next"}]}}
9: [choose_path, hint] Desktop Companion Story Overview: Add an engaging overview hint and story scroll layout on the initial story screen.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "story_scroll", "hint": "Your desktop pet lives right alongside your apps and keeps you company while you work."}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in within onboarding is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.
Redesigning pet choice layout while preserving the pet selection functionality is allowed.
Adding a new verification screen inside onboarding before home intro is allowed.
Redesigning the waiting screen while keeping its job of showing pet generation status is allowed.
Adding an informative hint to the sign-in screen is allowed.
Redesigning the choose path screen while maintaining both adopt and create options is allowed.
Adding background notifications to the waiting screen is allowed under Rule 4.
Adding step counter and time estimate info to the adoption certificate screen is allowed.
Adding interactive visual tip cards to the home intro overlay is allowed.
Redesigning the story screen with an overview hint and scroll layout is allowed.
